name: second-brain-changed-my-mind
title_zh: 翻你自己旧笔记，找出你什么时候改了主意
tagline_zh: 你写过的东西互相打架，自己却记不得哪次是对的。它按日期串起被推翻的旧立场、不同来源的矛盾。
tagline_en: Your own notes contradict each other and you can't recall which version won. It orders superseded claims by date.
desc_en: Trace where the user's recorded position on something has shifted: superseded claims, contradictions between sources of different dates, and what evidence moved them. Use this skill when the user asks what they have changed their mind about, how their thinking on a topic developed, what they used to believe, or wants a quarterly look back at their own positions. Do NOT use for finding contradictio
why_zh: 它不总结观点，只追踪观点的位移：哪句被哪句取代、隔了多久、靠什么证据。所以输出的是时间线，不是结论。
why_en: It doesn't summarize your views, it tracks their displacement: which claim replaced which, how long apart, on what evidence. You.
limit_zh: 只对已经写进笔记、且带日期的立场有效；口头想过没落笔的它查不到。跨来源矛盾只在同一主题下比对。
limit_en: Only works on positions already written down with dates; thoughts you never recorded are invisible. Cross-source conflicts need a shared topic tag.
title_en: Trace when your own notes changed your mind
